# Acknowledged oasdiff ERR-level changes for the api-breaking CI job.
#
# Only list a change here when the spec is being corrected to describe what
# the server already enforces, so no request that used to succeed is now
# rejected. Each entry must match oasdiff's method, path and message exactly
# (see `oasdiff breaking --err-ignore`), so new changes are still reported.
#
# ClusterConfig (X-Kafkito-Cluster payload, clusters _test body, topic copy
# dest_cluster_config): the server has always matched auth.type
# case-insensitively after trimming whitespace, and rejected blank broker
# entries with 400. The lowercase enum could not express that, so it became
# a pattern, and broker items gained the non-blank pattern.
POST /api/v1/clusters/_test removed the enum value `` of the request property `auth/type`
POST /api/v1/clusters/_test removed the enum value `none` of the request property `auth/type`
POST /api/v1/clusters/_test removed the enum value `plain` of the request property `auth/type`
POST /api/v1/clusters/_test removed the enum value `scram-sha-256` of the request property `auth/type`
POST /api/v1/clusters/_test removed the enum value `scram-sha-512` of the request property `auth/type`
POST /api/v1/clusters/_test added the pattern `^\s*(?:[Nn][Oo][Nn][Ee]|[Pp][Ll][Aa][Ii][Nn]|[Ss][Cc][Rr][Aa][Mm]-[Ss][Hh][Aa]-(?:256|512))?\s*$` to the request property `auth/type` This is a breaking change because adding a pattern restriction to a previously unrestricted parameter will reject values that were previously accepted, breaking existing clients
POST /api/v1/clusters/_test added the pattern `\S` to the request property `brokers/items/` This is a breaking change because adding a pattern restriction to a previously unrestricted parameter will reject values that were previously accepted, breaking existing clients
POST /api/v1/clusters/{cluster}/topics/{topic}/copy removed the enum value `` of the request property `dest_cluster_config/auth/type`
POST /api/v1/clusters/{cluster}/topics/{topic}/copy removed the enum value `none` of the request property `dest_cluster_config/auth/type`
POST /api/v1/clusters/{cluster}/topics/{topic}/copy removed the enum value `plain` of the request property `dest_cluster_config/auth/type`
POST /api/v1/clusters/{cluster}/topics/{topic}/copy removed the enum value `scram-sha-256` of the request property `dest_cluster_config/auth/type`
POST /api/v1/clusters/{cluster}/topics/{topic}/copy removed the enum value `scram-sha-512` of the request property `dest_cluster_config/auth/type`
POST /api/v1/clusters/{cluster}/topics/{topic}/copy added the pattern `^\s*(?:[Nn][Oo][Nn][Ee]|[Pp][Ll][Aa][Ii][Nn]|[Ss][Cc][Rr][Aa][Mm]-[Ss][Hh][Aa]-(?:256|512))?\s*$` to the request property `dest_cluster_config/auth/type` This is a breaking change because adding a pattern restriction to a previously unrestricted parameter will reject values that were previously accepted, breaking existing clients
POST /api/v1/clusters/{cluster}/topics/{topic}/copy added the pattern `\S` to the request property `dest_cluster_config/brokers/items/` This is a breaking change because adding a pattern restriction to a previously unrestricted parameter will reject values that were previously accepted, breaking existing clients
